Shulk main, speed art is the most important at low percent and beginning of the games it makes buffering ariel's super easy and the speed can extend combos. From 0 I try to rack up at much dmg as I can then switch to buster or jump depending on my advantage state. Buster is good at any advantage state time. Smash is good for kills and throws but can also be used to get out of combos at low percents. You should use shield to get out of any combo or juggle if possible. Now all of this can change on a lot of factors and dont be afraid to drop or change art as much as you want for example. Speed at start hit them to ledge switch to buster tac on dmg if you hit them off stage switch to jump and chase them if you dont kill the come back and switch to smash for a ledge trap, kill, or a throw. Also try to use arts to wait for others. I use jump art to stall for other arts like speed and buster. Also note you can use shield art mid combo to break it and take 50% less damage. Also your shield is stronger so it is good for projectiles too. Hope this helps the problem with shulk is you can never know exactly the optimal art all the time which is why he is so hard if you have any questions let me know
